title: Family in Vehicle
content: Hello. Had a weird anomaly yesterday. Was traveling on the usual windy roads with the crazy hills and so forth. Took a stop at one of the grassy parking areas that are muddy and full at night of people parked and waiting. Went up to one car, a black jeep it seemed like, and noticed a family of about 4-5 in there seemingly dead with their family dog watching them. It looked like they had been hurt or attacked quite badly, but in the dream, I knew to leave them alone. I knew not to be too curious and to go back on my way. Usually it’s plane rides, theatres, houses near the ocean with ufos, crazy beaches, and wandering around shops or having to bare a gross restroom. This was the first time I vividly recall seeing strangers and their faces.
